knowledge.prompt: Search the runbook for the symptom pattern described. Quote the relevant guidance. If nothing matches, say so plainly.

network.prompt: Check reachability of the endpoints triage flagged. A ping result is only meaningful together with its route: report the verdict verbatim and never upgrade an ambiguous verdict into a conclusion about hardware.

topology.prompt: Check eCAL wiring. A subscriber with no publisher means the node that should publish it is not running. Two disjoint PID groups publishing the same topics means two launcher sessions are running at once.

triage.prompt: Get the overall picture: which nodes are unhealthy, which are not running at all. Report what you see; do not speculate about causes yet. Name the affected nodes explicitly — later agents depend on that list.
